headline: Trump: U.S.-Iran Deal "Largely Negotiated"
summary: President Trump said a peace deal with Iran is largely negotiated, with final details under discussion. The agreement aims to reopen the Strait of Hormuz after a two-month ceasefire and ongoing negotiations.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so any deal affecting its reopening bears directly on crude oil supply expectations.
why_moved: Trump said a deal with Iran is largely negotiated and aims to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The strait is a key oil shipping lane, so reopening it would ease supply concerns.
